howto.what: 装上后，Claude能研究同类最佳产品，通过浏览器截取关键界面，搜索网络分析，提取设计模式并输出竞争分析报告。
howto.when: 在DIVERGE循环开始时、探索新UI模式或对比行业标准时触发。也可手动用“use competitor-scan skill”调用。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can research best-in-class products by taking browser screenshots of key flows, searching the web for teardowns, and extracting design patterns to output a competitive analysis report.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of a DIVERGE loop, when exploring new UI patterns, or when benchmarking against industry standards. Manual invocation via "use competitor-scan skill" is also possible.
